issues.title: Rider seating and mounting lifecycle
issues.root_cause: The animated saddle froze seatFromSource once at attachment from the rider pelvis in that single frame, so the seat height depended on the rider animation when Mount Companion fired (cast clip, an approach walk blending out) or a view's first frame after load; a remount from an idle stance seats lower. No accumulation or stale anchor (frame lease and release verified in source). Alpha 4: no literal basis; the Horse seat settles on the rider's own still pose measured live in the mount root frame and is logged on every attachment.

issues.title: TB approach into legal melee range

issues.title: Unintended horse bite Trip
issues.root_cause: The KMC Horse copies the stock Mammoth companion AddFacts, which in installed 2.1.7b data are exactly [TrippingBite, NaturalArmor7, TripDefenseFourLegs]; TrippingBite is ManeuverOnAttack(Bite, Trip). Inert on a Mammoth (no bite), it fires on every KMC Horse bite hit.

issues.title: Visible native horse bite
issues.root_cause: Installed data: native HorseAnimationSet_Bite is a UnitAnimationActionSpecialAttack with one dedicated clip BiteAttack (hoof: Right/Left_Hoof_Attack). The ordinary routine Bite/Hoof/Hoof plays the stock Bite handle (adopted, not replaced). Native UnitAttack.ConfigureAnimations scales every limb clip of a routine into one window (one SpeedScale), a plausible reason a short bite reads as invisible; not visually confirmed.
